description: Purchase timestamp, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, between 2023-10-27 and 2026-10-26.
Value of one order in currency units (simulated Gamma-Gamma spend; anomalies are bulk-like or near-zero).
Ground-truth label: True for the ~3% of rows that were injected as anomalies (known only because the data are simulated).
Result of the label-free detection rule (near-zero order, over 5x the customer's median, or above Q3+7*IQR). Rows flagged True are removed before modelling.
Repeat purchases (total purchases minus the first).
Days between a customer's first and last purchase (BG/NBD convention; not days since last purchase).
Customer age in days: first purchase to 2026-10-26.
Average order value over repeat purchases (0 if none).
BG/NBD probability the customer is still active (0-1).
Expected number of purchases in the next 365 days.
Gamma-Gamma expected order value (population mean of repeat buyers if the customer has no repeat purchase).
12-month CLV = expected purchases x expected order value / 1.10 (10% annual discount).
CLV tier: Low (bottom 50%), Medium, High, Top 5%.
Retention action: VIP retention, Loyalty / cross-sell, Standard nurture, One-time buyer nudge, or Lapsed reactivation (P(alive) < 0.3).
